pages.title: Upgrading Your Heaters
pages.text: Upgrades increase heating power. Open camps also retain the listed proximity radius.$(br2)$(li)Iron: 50 output, 9-block radius, 1.5x fuel cost$(li)Gold: 65 output, 11-block radius, 2x fuel cost$(li)Diamond: 80 output, 14-block radius, 3x fuel cost$(br2)Inside sealed rooms, geometry determines coverage. Higher output speeds warm-up; insulation and the selected target determine holding demand.

pages.title: Shelter & Strategy
pages.text: In Phase 5+, an exposed open-camp heater retains 0.6x radius. A real roof preserves its full radius.$(br2)Phase scaling increases full-rate fuel use: 2x in Phase 4,4x in Phase 5 and8x in Phase 6. Throttling reduces actual ordinary burn.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA’s “bonfire strategy” now has a thermostat. The invoice still has thirty heaters.$()

pages.title: Iron Thermal Heater
pages.text: Surround a Thermal Heater with 8 iron ingots. A solid upgrade for Phase 3-4. The heater gets warmer and hungrier. Like Kevin at a buffet.

pages.title: Gold Thermal Heater
pages.text: Surround a Thermal Heater with 8 gold ingots. Greater power speeds room warm-up; the extended proximity radius helps open camps.

pages.title: Diamond Thermal Heater
pages.text: Eight diamonds around a Thermal Heater. High heating power and 3x fuel cost. Sealed rooms still share the target.$(br2)ORSA Engineering has never heard of “affordable.”
